# anthropic_invites (Data Source)

Lists all invitations in the Anthropic organization (`GET /v1/organizations/invites`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `invites` (Attributes List) List of organization invitations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the invited user.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation expires.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the invite.
- `invited_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the invitation was sent.
- `role` (String) Organization-level role assigned to the invitation.
- `status` (String) Current status of the invite (`pending`, `accepted`, `expired`, `deleted`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`invite`).
